title: Annotatio III §.VIII Rescript open: Frederick King of Prussia to Bishop Ursinus — greeting
pass_a_gloss:
Thus indeed it has:
We by the Grace of God FREDERICK KING OF PRUSSIA etc. etc.
Our Greeting and Clemency!
Most Reverend Bishop, Beloved and Faithful.
pass_b_english: We, by God’s grace, Frederick King of Prussia, etc.
Most Reverend Bishop, beloved and faithful.
source_text:
Ita verò habet:
Nos Dei Gratia FRIDERICUS REX BORUSSIAE &c. &c.
Salutem & Clementiam nostram!
Admodum Reverende Episcope, Dilecte & Fidelis.
notes: Rescript protocol open; Frederick I of Prussia to Ursinus.
